residual_risks: P1187-01 'operational' covers an installation whose DUB15 was still in phased commissioning with part of its site under construction at end-2025. Only installation-level operation is established; partially_operational is not an admission status.

The noise-survey operating sentence is boilerplate repeated across P1187/P1190/P1191 and is used as of the issue date. The July measurement days (23-31 Jul) fall outside the window and are not relied on.

P1190-01 AER mentions legacy-room decommissioning, and LEAP lists a 'DB3 F-gas disposal March 2026' item. A partial decommissioning inside DB3 cannot be excluded, though the installation operated in Aug 2026.

EdgeConneX operating text is unchanged since at least the 23 Mar 2026 version. The 27 Aug edit touched only a form, so the in-window date rests on a bounded page modification, not on new content. This is the same pattern accepted for Teraco and Sify Bengaluru.

The inherited EdgeConneX locator is the P1204-01 point west of the R120, about 420-460 m from the DUB01/DUB02 permissions. The Microsoft locator is 430 m and 692 m from the P1187/P1190 points. Both offsets are disclosed in the host precision text, but no building is located.
